title: Language-guided Detection and Mitigation of Unknown Dataset Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating digit classification accuracy on the CMNIST dataset, where specific colors are strongly correlated with specific digits, causing the model to overfit to the color attribute.

Evaluating bird species classification on the Waterbirds dataset, where backgrounds (water or land) are strongly correlated with bird types, testing the model's reliance on context rather than the actual object.

Evaluating hair color classification (blonde vs. non-blonde) on the CelebA facial image dataset, where gender is spuriously correlated with the target attribute (e.g., blonde hair is predominantly associated with females in the dataset).
